name: TestApp E-Commerce Demo - Intelligent Test Suite
description: Comprehensive test suite generated from 4 user stories, 3 features, and 1 critical flows

scenarios.name: User Login - Happy Path
scenarios.description: User can log into the system
preconditions: User is logged in as Admin

flow.description: User can enter email and password
User is redirected to dashboard on success
Error message shown on invalid credentials

scenarios.expectedBehavior: User can enter email and password; System validates credentials; User is redirected to dashboard on success; Error message shown on invalid credentials

scenarios.name: User Registration - Happy Path
scenarios.description: New user can create an account
preconditions: User is logged in as Admin

flow.description: User can enter name, email, and password

scenarios.expectedBehavior: User can enter name, email, and password; Passwords must match; Email must be unique; Terms must be accepted

scenarios.name: Browse Products - Happy Path
scenarios.description: User can view and search products
preconditions: User is logged in as Admin

flow.description: Products are displayed in a table

scenarios.expectedBehavior: Products are displayed in a table; Can search by name; Can filter by category

scenarios.name: Place Order - Happy Path
scenarios.description: User can place an order for a product
preconditions: User is logged in as Admin
scenarios.expectedBehavior: User can select quantity; User must enter shipping address; Order is created on submit
